policy.ownerDecision: Verified exact-SKU product dimensions and weight are sufficient; outer shipping-package measurements are not required.
policy.conflictHandling: A conflict in package/other scope does not block an independently explicit exact-SKU product measurement; product-vs-product conflicts remain blocked.
policy.mixedExactEvidence: Allowed when dimensions and weight are independently tied to the same exact SKU/EAN; outer shipping-box data is not required. Low-confidence volume-like weights and family-only geometry remain blocked.
